items.title: Photos: These shepherds climb down a mountain to go to night school
items.summary: Many thousands of boys and men in Lesotho take up the vital profession of herding but have to give up their education. A small network of schools on a shoestring budget is teaching them the ABCs.

items.title: The U.S. has more thalidomide survivors than the government admits
items.summary: In the 1950s and 1960s, doctors gave the drug thalidomide to pregnant patients without telling them — and without FDA approval. Now those patients' children want recognition.
